title: Sleep that works
line: Switches off the fingerprint reader, which has no Linux driver and breaks sleep.
symptom: Suspend/resume is unreliable on the GPD Win 4 and Win Max 2 because of their USB fingerprint readers.
why: The GPD fingerprint readers 2808:9338 (WIN 4) and 2541:9711 (WIN Max 2), which have no Linux driver.
risk_note: One udev rule, the same one Bazzite ships. The fingerprint reader (which has no Linux driver) is switched off.

changes.detail: Removes the fingerprint reader (2808:9338 on the WIN 4, 2541:9711 on the WIN Max 2) from the USB bus when it appears.

undo: Deletes the rule. The reader is back after a restart.
steamos: Not shipped (GPD isn't a SteamOS device).

probe.what: Looks for the system's own rule for the reader this unit has (Bazzite ships one per model, 50-gpd-win-4-fingerprint.rules and 50-gpd-wm2-fingerprint.rules; a rule for the other model's reader doesn't count), or the value already being right without GameCove.
